excludedNonSovereignDomains.note: Three clearing domains are not sovereign states and stay registry-only in data/rails.json. They are never emitted as jurisdiction nodes.
excludedNonSovereignDomains.HK: Hong Kong SAR — special administrative region, clears on HK_FPS
excludedNonSovereignDomains.TW: Taiwan — de facto jurisdiction with its own central bank, clears on CBC_INTERBANK
excludedNonSovereignDomains.XK: Kosovo — not a UN member, clears on XK_RTGS

conventions.primaryRailId: Foreign key into data/rails.json. Euro-area and Eurosystem participants settle on TARGET2; CEMAC on ME_RGT, UEMOA on WAEMU_RTGS, ECCU on ECCB_RTGS; markets with no distinct domestic high-value rail fall back to SWIFT_RTGS.
conventions.alternateRails: primaryRailId is the default rail for a credit into that state, not the only rail that reaches it. data/rails.json also carries retail and high-value alternates for the same market (PIX and BR_STR for Brazil, IMPS/NEFT/RTGS_IN for India, CHAPS and FPS for the United Kingdom) and the registry-only domains for Hong Kong, Taiwan and Kosovo, which have no jurisdiction node.
conventions.percentages: baselineWhtPct and treatyWhtPct are percentages (0-100), never decimal fractions. 0 means no statutory withholding on the remittance, not a missing value.
conventions.rateSemantics: baselineWhtPct is the domestic band absent relief; treatyWhtPct is the band available once treaty or domestic exemption conditions are evidenced.
conventions.primaryBankBics: ISO 9362 BICs (8 or 11 characters) of the principal receiving banks. Empty arrays are intentional where no rail-local BIC is published for the market; the audit validates syntax only on entries that are present.
conventions.statutoryAct: A named act is cited only where a public, citable statute governs the remittance. Where a state has no standalone outbound service withholding act, the authority is named and the bands are 0/0 rather than a fabricated citation.
